question: Related Questions Q. Qaza-e-Umri instead of Sunnah Muwakkidah 6207 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2930 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1128 Country: India Title: I am working in Singapore and follow Hanafi maslak. The mosques here have seperate section for the women to pray.(men not allowed in those sections, i.e. full seclusion from men's praying area) Given these conditions, what is the command as per the Hanafi maslak for women to pray in mosques? Can you please specify the rules for the conitions when there is any other option avaliable and otherwise. Question: Asalam-ala-i-kum, I am working in Singapore and follow Hanafi maslak. The mosques here have seperate section for the women to pray.(men not allowed in those sections, i.e. full seclusion from men's praying area) Given these conditions, what is the command as per the Hanafi maslak for women to pray in mosques? Can you please specify the rules for the conitions when there is any other option avaliable and otherwise. Answer ID: 1128 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 816/816=J) It is Makrooh-e-Tahreemi (undesirable to an extent of haram ) for women to go to mosque for praying salah with jamat . But, if they attend mosque at night with their husbands observing purdah then it may be allowable. After all, their salah in house is more virtuous and better than in mosques. When at the time of Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), praying salah behind the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) was not better than praying in houses then how can it be better in this age of mischief behind a common Muslim? عن ام حمید امرأة ابی حمید الساعدی انھا جاءت النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فقالت: یا رسول اللہ! انی احب الصلاۃ معک، قال: قد علمت انک تحبین الصلاۃ معی و صلاتک فی بیتک خیر من صلاتک فی حجرتک و صلاتک فی حجرتک خیر من صلاتک فی دارک و صلاتک فی دارک خیر من صلاتک فی مسجد قومک و صلاتک فی مسجد قومک خیر من صلاتک فی مسجدی، قال فامرت فبنی لھا مسجد فی اقصی شئ من بیتھا و اظلمہ، فکانت تصلی فیہ حتی لقیت اللہ عز و جل (کذا فی مجمع الزوائد: 2/33،34) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
